When a result promises complete parsing, traversal, construction, or search, exhausting Nat fuel before the input is consumed is an explicit failure or partial result, or a stated bound covers every recursive step. Silently substituting an empty tree, missing node, truncated token stream, or successful partial parse breaks this rule. If no such traversal exists, this rule holds.
